Question 7
?
Consider the differential equation dydx−3y=6e2x. Select the correct options below. An integrating factor for this equation is I(x)=
 
e3x
e−3x
e2x
e−2x
.

The general solution is given by y(x)=
 
−6e−x+Ce−3x
−6e2x+Ce3x
6e2x+Ce3x
6e−2x+Ce−3x
.
Submit
